summary.en: The police verified their alibis when the crime was carried out, Tsurumi was tied to a lamppost at the bicycle parking area using the handcuffs, after being discovered by the victim. Torahiko bumped into some thugs and got into a fight with them near the entrance of the shrine, thanks to that, this attarcted loads of attentions towards the fight and gave the oppurtunity for the crime to be implemented without testimonies. Finally, Kyouma was finding his wallet during that time. Ironically, their reason to be at the shrine and unable to get out are all related to the crime of another individual: Shamoto quit shoplifting when she married to a man that is able to support her life, but went back to shoplifting at the temple when her husband got hit by Kawano. Kawano came to the shrine to take a stamp card for his younger sister, who was very sad after being swindled by Kyouma. Kyouma came to the shrine to buy “tools” to manipulate women, but his wallet was stolen by Shamoto. Conan proposed another assumption, since there was a box used to store the flag poles and flags, those were supposed to be set up already, but due to the fight outbroke by Torahiko, the staff resposible for putting the flags went to spectate. The culprit might put the weapon pole inside the box, however, Sato rejected this theory, because forensics examined the stuff inside it, which did not find a match to the victim's blood component. So, where did the culprit hide the flag pole?
